blurb: Guests enjoy river boat tours on a custom tiki-style catamaran with views of Portland's skyline and bridges. Tours operate rain or shine with a waterproof palapa top. Private charters are customizable for events like corporate outings, parties, and celebrations.
extraNote: No outside food or drinks allowed on board · Tours sail rain or shine; waterproof palapa top covers most of the boat · Full refund for cancellations up to 48 hours before scheduled departure · If captain cancels due to unsafe conditions, full refund issued · Arrive 30 minutes before tour start; late arrivals forfeit ticket and cost · Tips not included but appreciated; payment via QR code or cash jar · South Waterfront Park on the Willamette River in downtown Portland, Oregon
